coverage.assessment: The Niagara ratio, begonia and King payoffs all hold. The shaken-credit setup behind 'small notes' was cut in the first draft, but 'King Banker' and 'distrust of bankers' partly carry it. The revision's cut of Hay's resignation blurs why none of the trio holds office.

'Their chief title… their windows' now follows the three named readers, so the possessives seem to refer to Hewitt, McVeagh and Hay rather than to Hay and Adams. Paragraph 3's 'They pursued it' lost its antecedent ('the combination') in both drafts, but the meaning is recoverable. The London–Paris–Yorkshire–Teutonic route stays clear.
Brice's quip is correctly about Cleveland and extended to Harrison. Lamar's formula is attributed to Lamar. Hay's Boutwell line is kept as his performed speech.

Hay's exit from office is gone, so 'stayed there to write' reads as if he wrote while holding the post. Minor hedges such as 'perhaps the best President… since Lincoln' and 'less respect for money than the European' were dropped in the first draft without material distortion.
The wife and the occasion of the figure are never mentioned. 'Made for him in his absence' preserves the source's reticence, and King's ruin is not narrated.

Triads, semicolon chains and the closing punchline survive. The revision's cut of the stateroom wonder breaks the 'double—even treble' build. The cut of the teacher-as-criminal sentence softens the opening's indictment.

The mirror principle survives, but the source contrast is lost: absorbed in every detail, Adams never questioned the meaning. The Kipling passage keeps only European condescension and drops the American on 'his literary knees', so the reciprocal relation is halved.
All four dependencies are intact at both endpoints in this run's drafts of 021, 010, 027 and 022.

strengths: Every verbatim anchor (V1–V8) is preserved, including the stable image and the closing 'dead men' punchline.
Brice's Cleveland quip, its extension to Harrison, and Lamar's courteous formula are attributed correctly.
The Rock Creek passage keeps the author's silence about whom the figure commemorates while preserving the clergy as mirror-gazers.
The added Niagara gloss is minimal and lets the acceleration ratio land without the reader recalling chapter 010.
summary: The revision keeps the chapter's frame, every verbatim anchor, the four planned dependencies and the plan's silence about the Rock Creek figure. Several cuts new to this pass do damage, however. Deleting Hay's book paragraph leaves 'their chief title… their windows' attached to the three readers, a referent problem the first draft already contained. Removing Hay's resignation lets 'stayed there' suggest he kept his post. Dropping 'never once thought of questioning what it meant' weakens the Rock Creek premise. The Teutonic's 'double—even treble' wonder now follows a single wonder. Other losses are defensible compressions.
